title: James Clerk Maxwell Telescope
geometryBasis: The OpenStreetMap building way and co-located observatory identity point provide the plan. The exact public-domain Qualla photograph shows the proportions, coated steel, overhanging rim and concrete base.
sectionBasis: The University of Hawaiʻi conservation district application documents a 100-foot high white enclosure. The operator describes a co-rotating building housing the 15-metre dish.
limitations: The capture represents one closed position of the revolving shell. Roof shutter bearings, maintenance features and small openings are interpreted from the exterior reference.
The 15-metre reflector and its mechanisms remain inside the exterior shell. Adjacent observatories are outside this entry.
